name: protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 1
pathways: negative regulation of MAP kinase activity

function.text: PTPN1 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 1. Annotated molecular activities include phosphoprotein phosphatase activity and protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. It participates in negative regulation of MAP kinase activity and regulation of signal transduction.
